submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. One native high-definition square 1254x1254 transparent RGBA game sprite, no sheet. Image 1 is edit target and exact geometry/arm ownership reference; image 2 definitive character identity for costume only; image 3 approved PRIMARY bright clean rounded Daoist chibi hand-painted style.
Edit image 1 into hit reaction EAST ending frame 06/06. Make only these small articulated changes: slightly bend the near right elbow to bring the fan 2% canvas height upward and 1% canvas width closer to the chest, keeping the same fan grip; lower the far left empty hand by about 2% canvas height and relax its fingers; straighten the torso from slight backward tilt to fully centered; settle the robe hem and blue tassels into a quieter hanging curve. Keep alert blue eye, closed mouth, same two boot positions, head size and grounded body scale. The pose remains facing screen RIGHT. CRITICAL preserve the existing anatomy exactly: the LARGE FOREGROUND SHOULDER on screen-left side of chest connects through the LARGE FOREGROUND SLEEVE to the FAN-GRIPPING HAND. Do not detach that sleeve from the fan hand. The small background sleeve on the screen-right side ends in the EMPTY LEFT HAND. Keep this arm ownership and occlusion exactly as image 1. Keep the hip jade where it is on far LEFT hip, mostly occluded.
Preserve navy straight layered hair/small ponytail, turquoise-gold ornament/blue tassel, blue/ivory/gold scholar robe, cloud-wave patterns and ivory-blue dragon fan. Exactly two arms/hands/legs/boots. Same face identity, proportions, alpha-edge quality and full-body margins. True transparent background, no UI/text/labels, no shadow/floor, no particles/effects, no motion blur. No mirroring or pose-copy substitute.
